{{Pisces}}
Pisces 21 is the 105th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 21st day of Pisces, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 15, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 4宮21日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 105|Chapter 105]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152125}}.
